datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Uganda to assess acute food insecurity conditions and classify geographic areas using the IPC framework. Survey data were spatially aggregated and classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing severity levels, with results published as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) for January, April, July, and October 2014 medium-term projections.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity and affected population estimates across geographic areas.
